lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: How many did you finish?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: 2 sir.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Okay. Explain this one. Why are you sorting by start time?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I copied, sir.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Wow. At least learn how it works. What is even the point of this lab if you copy from others?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: --then he wasted 6-7 minutes of your life--

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Are you a res student?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: No

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Then don't try to sneak in please

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: SNEAK AROUND!!! How could I?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hey, Shaquib. What's up?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Don't hey me, buddy. Have you done your part?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: What part are you talking about?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Huhh??? Man, the project deadline's been shifted to 2 days. You didn't even check my messages!!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Sorry bruv, But remember I told about this girl I met some time ago, Sofia. And you know it's my first love.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Look, I'm happy for your love and all that, but you need to work, bruv.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I would love to start as I am free after the classes. But....

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: But what?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You see, my laptop's at her place. Her laptop broke a few days ago and she needed to work on her project.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Of course. You gave your laptop to your girlfriend to finish her project. While you don't even know the deadline of your own project. The irony truly amazes me

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Well, yeah, it's my fault, man. I completely forgot. But her work is finished, she told me yesterday.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Then go grab the laptop from her and start working.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Well, about that, I can't go there!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: What? why?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Well, you see, I have almost zero attendance in the classes and I don't wanna be seen with a girl on campus. So...

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: So YOU WANT ME TO GET YOUR LAPTOP FROM HER!!!!!!!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Please, for old times' sake???

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You don't even see my texts, and you say for old times' sake…………. Whatever, where is she?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Well, you'll find her at the roadside of female hall.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: And when I ask, she will give it, right? You talked to her about it, right?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Yes, yes, she'll give it to you right away. Just...uhh... You see, she might send you off for some work, and I said yes!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You WANT ME TO RUN ERRANDS FOR YOUR GIRLFRIEND!! THIS JUST GETS BETTER AND BETTER!!!!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Please don't say anything to her. I swear I owe you one.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Oh, you owe me big time, buddy.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Did you get my laptop from Sofia yet? She is at the gate of female hall

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I am on it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hey, you must be Shaquib.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Hey, and I presume you are Sofia, Rafat's girlfriend?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hushhh, you don't want everybody to know we're dating!!!!!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: So give me the laptop now!??

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ah, about that... it is in my room. You see, I just got back from classes.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Well, then go and fetch it!!!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, I am going. Meanwhile, can you please bring the ordered pizza from CDS, pretty please?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: "There you go, the errands."

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, I'll go, but be sure to bring that laptop.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Did you get the pizza yet?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hey, what do you need? We have pizza, burgers, sandwiches—

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Hey man, just wait a bit. I was told that there was an order for a pizza.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ohh, you must be a delivery boy. Are you here to pick it up?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: "Delivery boy!!!!!!"

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Apparently, yes. Can you bring me the pizza?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Yeah, sure man. Here you go. The money has already been paid. Thanks for the order, and of course, for picking it up!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Can't say the gratitude is likewise, my friend!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Here's the pizza. Now can I have that laptop?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Well, yes, here it is... But wait, can you do something else for me, please?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I assume you won't take no for an answer! So just tell me what to do?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You see, tomorrow's our one-month anniversary. So I ordered a gift for Rafat.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: So, can you pick up the gift and give it to him? The delivery man should be in front of the male hall. Here's the order ID. Give this to the delivery man and pick up the gift.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: What has become of my life?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Assalamualaikum sir, did you have an order?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Well, yes! The order ID is #Ord-6776.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Here's your product, sir. Thank you for ordering. Hope you have a nice day.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Yeah man, I wish!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hey man. You're back.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Don't say a word. Here's your laptop, so go to work. And here's your one-month anniversary gift.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Oh, she remembered! My honeybee, my-

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Ohh, stop it! Just take these and start working. I can't take this cheesiness anymore.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Yeah man, I'll go now. Thanks again.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You better finish everything without causing any more trouble... and learn to read everyone's texts!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Hey, Shafeen. What's up?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Oh hey, Shaquib. I'm doing good. Have you seen the deadline notification? It's good that we finished earlier.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Yeah, I have seen that. Wait, what?? You guys have already finished?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Yes, almost everybody is finished.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: "Wow. Looks like my team is in real trouble now."

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Well, apparently we still have a lot to do...

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Then you must do it fast. Talking about teammates, who are you with?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Talha and Rafat. By the way, have you seen those two?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I don't know about Rafat, but today's the CSE/EEE football final... so you know where to look for Talha.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Right. Thanks for the info. Then I'll leave now.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Okay, see you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Shouldn't you look for Talha? He should be near CDS, preparing for the match.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Yeah, I am heading over there now.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Hey, what are you doing here, man? We have a full project to do, and only 40 or something hours left!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: What??? Wasn't the deadline a month away? How come we only have a day and a half?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Well, it was shifted. Duhhh. So, when are you going to work?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Man, you see that we have this CSE vs EEE game today. I must play and can't leave the game!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Bruv, your semester is on the line!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I know, man. Wait, lemme think what I can do!!!!!! Hey, you and I look kinda the same...

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Hey, I don't like the idea, whatever you are going to say.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I haven't even said anything.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I can sense it. You're going to tell me to play, aren't you?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Well, you are a brilliant player, so why not?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: But I planned not to play. I retired!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Please, just this once! For the sake of the game?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Arghhh, whatever. Finish your part. I will sub for you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: No worries, boss. I will work hard. So promise me you won't lose.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Are you ready to play now?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Well done! You've played brilliantly.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Thanks, but what are you doing here? Weren't you supposed to work?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Relax, I have started working. I just hit my limit on Claude. It's supposed to reset in... seven minutes. Anyway have you seen my lungi?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Why would you need a lungi now?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Well, gonna show those blueberries who their father is!!!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Dude.... You didn't even play...

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Man, I let you play and you sink the whole department.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I am sorry, man... Wait, what are you doing here??? You're supposed to work!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Relax, I was only here because my Claude reached its limit. It's supposed to reset in....6 or 7 minutes, but I got to see your stupid play.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Yeah, whatever. Just finish the project within the deadline.
